items.name: Weddings
items.summary: Nepali, Hindu and modern weddings, photographed and filmed from the first ritual to the last dance.
items.intro: We cover a wedding the way it actually unfolds: Haldi, Mehndi, Sangeet, the ceremony and the reception. We know the rituals and the timing, so we stay close to the people who matter and only step in where it helps.
includes: Coverage planned around your run sheet
Extra days for Haldi, Mehndi, Sangeet or reception
A sneak peek within a week
Full edited gallery and film, delivered online
items.audience: Couples and families who want the whole celebration told as one story, rituals and all.
process: A conversation about the day, the people and what matters most to you
A written plan covering locations, timings and the moments you cannot miss
Coverage on the day, working quietly around the celebration
A sneak peek within a week, followed by the full gallery and film

faqs.question: How do we check availability?
faqs.answer: Send an enquiry with your date and we will get back to you quickly to confirm.

faqs.question: Do you offer photography and video together?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can book stills, film, or both. Whichever you choose, it is shot by the same team with the same eye.

faqs.question: How long can we access our photos?
faqs.answer: Your photos and films arrive as a private download link that stays active for 90 days, which is plenty of time to download everything and share it with family. After that it is archived. If you need it again later, just ask and we will restore it at no cost.

faqs.question: Do you travel outside Canberra?
faqs.answer: Yes, anywhere in Australia. Travel and accommodation are quoted on top of your package so you can see exactly what they add.

gallery.alt: A Nepali bride and groom smiling at each other in front of a thangka

items.name: Pre-wedding
items.summary: Engagements, proposals, pre-wedding shoots and maternity sessions, relaxed and unhurried.
items.intro: These shoots are about the two of you. We pick a location and a time of day with good light, keep the posing gentle, and leave room for the real moments in between.
includes: Up to 90 minutes, up to two locations
Help choosing a location and outfits
Photography, a short film, or both
items.audience: Couples planning a proposal, celebrating an engagement, or expecting a baby.
process: A chat about the two of you and the feel you want
A relaxed shoot in good light

faqs.question: Can you help plan a surprise proposal?
faqs.answer: Yes. We will plan where to stand, how to stay out of sight and when to start shooting, so the moment stays a surprise.

faqs.question: Is a pre-wedding shoot cheaper with a wedding booking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask us about the pre-wedding price when you book your wedding.

items.name: Family and community events
items.summary: Pasni, birthdays, puja and community gatherings, covered with care for the people and the customs.
items.intro: Family events move quickly and never happen the same way twice. We learn the programme and the customs beforehand, so the first bite of rice, the blessing or the cake are caught as they happen.
includes: Pasni (weaning ceremony), birthdays, puja and community events
items.audience: Families and community groups who want the day, the rituals and everyone who came, remembered properly.
process: A short chat about the programme, the venue and who must be photographed
Coverage planned around the key moments
Quiet, respectful shooting through the event

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.answer: The earlier the better, especially for weekend dates.

faqs.question: Can you deliver same day highlights?
faqs.answer: Not on the night itself. You will get a sneak peek within a week, followed by the full edited gallery and film.

faqs.question: How long can we access the files?
faqs.answer: Your files arrive as a private download link that stays active for 90 days, so there is time to download and share everything you need. After that it is archived, and we will happily restore it on request.

faqs.question: Do you understand the rituals?
faqs.answer: Yes. We share a Nepalese background and photograph Pasni, puja and cultural events often. If your family does things differently, tell us and we will plan around it.
